bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first Point of Sale & Inventory Management System
bundle.longDescription: PicoPOSSUM is an offline-first desktop Point of Sale and Inventory Management System designed for small retail and commercial businesses. It provides high-speed billing, inventory tracking, financial analytics, customer records, and local backup automation.
